exposure: Perinatal Anxiety Screening Scale-Turkish version (PASS-TR) score
cohort: 162 pregnant women planning vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) who were recruited via Google Forms between February 23 and August 17, 2022
finding: Perinatal anxiety was present in 54.3% of pregnant women planning VBAC, but it was not significantly associated with the type of delivery after cesarean section.
gest_age: 37 or more weeks in 54.9% of participants
